mode: YOLO — user decisions supplied in the spawn prompt; code findings verified by reading the files cited

functional.description: Saving a Studio secret writes its value to Vault KV v2 and nowhere else. No secret value is persisted in the application database.
functional.rationale: V1: SecretsService.create stores the value as plaintext bytes in `secrets.encrypted_value` (SecretsService.java:42, TODO AES-GCM). V2: nothing writes to Vault.

functional.description: The Vault path of a Studio secret is scoped by CSI, environment and test id, plus the secret name. Both the save path and the run-time lookup (acceptance preflight and dispatch resolve) use the same path.
functional.rationale: V3/V4/V5: pathTemplateOrDefault() = studio/{csiId}/{environment}/{kind}/{referenceName} has no test id; save goes to DB while run reads Vault; DB table has no CSI column.

functional.description: Creating a secret is a test-scoped operation: the caller names the test; the server takes CSI and environment from the persisted test row, never from the request.
functional.rationale: User decision 4. UITest has id, csiId and environment (environment NOT NULL, UITest.java:67-68).

functional.description: The Studio secret list for a test comes from a Vault KV v2 metadata LIST under that test's path prefix. It returns names only.
Drop the `secrets` table with forward Flyway migration V25 (purges plaintext rows) and remove the `com.citi.put.checks.secrets` package (entity, repository, service, controller, DTOs).
functional.rationale: User decision 1. Table created in V1__init.sql:243, column added by V4__secrets_encrypted_value.sql. Latest migration is V24__studio_reference_policy.sql.
User decision 3. SecretsController.java:41 / SecretsService.java:66 return value "REDACTED"; VaultStudioReferenceResolver is the real resolver.

functional.description: With vault provider `none`, list and create answer 503 with a stable error code and never fall back to any other store.
Connecting Vault requires only environment variables: provider, address, token file, and optionally namespace, mount, path template. Startup validation covers the new path template and fails closed.
functional.rationale: User decision 2. application-dev.yml:30 and application-local.yml:79 hard-code `provider: none`, which overrides STUDIO_VAULT_PROVIDER from application.yml:203.

functional.description: The frontend secret picker lists and creates secrets for a specific test and stores the secret name as the variable's secretId.
functional.rationale: CompileInputs.from (CompileInputs.java:67) declares `secretId` (falling back to the variable name) as the vars.secret reference; VaultStudioReferenceResolver uses that string as the Vault referenceName. Today SecretInput stores the DB UUID returned by POST /secrets, which can never be a Vault key the resolver finds.

functional.description: Update misleading comments/docs that describe the DB store or the REDACTED stub (application.yml:129, application.yml:201-203, ConfiguredSecretUseAuthorization javadoc, ExternallyGatedCriteriaTest skip text, ARCH.md secrets table section).

nonFunctional.description: A secret value is never logged, never returned in any response, never persisted outside Vault, and never placed in a URI.
nonFunctional.metric: Canary value asserted absent from: every response body, captured log output, DB (no table exists), request URI seen by the stub Vault server.

nonFunctional.description: Values are handled as char[] from request deserialization to the Vault write and erased (zero-filled) on every exit path, including errors. The serialized HTTP body buffer is zeroed after send; platform-created transient strings are the named residual, as already stated for Resolved (StudioReferenceResolver.java AC-15 note).
nonFunctional.metric: Unit test asserts the request's char[] is all '\0' after both success and Vault-failure paths.

nonFunctional.description: Write requires CSI write permission on the test's CSI; list requires read permission. Absent, soft-deleted and unauthorized tests are indistinguishable (403 STUDIO_ACCESS_DENIED).
nonFunctional.metric: Controller tests for owner, reader, non-member, absent test id.

nonFunctional.description: Vault calls reuse the existing bounded transport: connect timeout, request deadline, max-response-bytes, no redirects, token from mounted file.
nonFunctional.metric: Stalled-body and oversized-response tests pass for list as they do for read.

nonFunctional.description: Vault outage is distinguishable from not-configured and from not-found.
nonFunctional.metric: 503 VAULT_UNAVAILABLE (outage) vs 503 VAULT_NOT_CONFIGURED (provider none) vs empty list / UNKNOWN_REFERENCE (absent).

constraints.description: Vault provider default stays `none`; dev entitlement config (studio.secrets.entitlements / ConfiguredSecretUseAuthorization) stays.
constraints.impact: Feature is ready but off. Frontend flag STUDIO_CAPABILITIES.vaultSecrets stays false.

constraints.description: Production secret-use policy (V6) is PUT Core's work; platform Vault connection (V7) is the platform's. Neither is designed here.
constraints.impact: Recorded as externally blocked; no new policy model (Constitution Art. IV).

constraints.description: Flyway is forward-only; next version is V25.
constraints.impact: Table drop is irreversible; plaintext rows are purged by design.

constraints.description: Secret names must be valid `<secret ID>` step tokens: [A-Za-z0-9_.-]{1,64} (VariableReferenceValidator.java:38), and path-safe for HashicorpStudioVaultProvider.segment (rejects '/', '\\', '.', '..').
constraints.impact: Name regex enforced on create in backend and frontend.

constraints.description: A secret whose Vault entry carries no valid allowedOrigins cannot be filled on any origin (SecretOrigins, HashicorpStudioVaultProvider.read warning path).
constraints.impact: Create must require at least one valid origin, stored in the exact comma-separated form the reader parses.

constraints.description: Studio API lives under /api/v1/studio (StudioController @RequestMapping). Test ids are UUIDs.
No code or git changes during spec phases; ~230 unrelated uncommitted changes exist in the working tree.
constraints.impact: Implementation story must not sweep unrelated files.

assumptions.description: Vault KV v2 semantics: POST /v1/{mount}/data/{path} with {"options":{"cas":0},"data":{...}} writes only if the key does not exist; LIST (or GET ?list=true) on /v1/{mount}/metadata/{prefix} returns data.keys, folders suffixed '/', and 404 when the prefix is empty. Taken from HashiCorp public API docs, not verified against the platform's Vault version (research phase skipped).
The platform will issue a Vault token whose policy grants create on {mount}/data/studio/* and list on {mount}/metadata/studio/*. Not in this repo's control.
No production data in `secrets` needs migration to Vault: the provider is `none` everywhere and the only writer stored plaintext under an M3 TODO. User decision 1 accepts the purge.

Check-level UI_TEST variable overrides (wizard uiVariables.secretId) are not consumed by the backend: no Java outside the studio package references UI_TEST or uiTest (grep). The wizard picker therefore only selects among the chosen test's own secrets.

domainModel.description: Studio draft: id (UUID), csiId, environment (NOT NULL).

Vault KV v2 entry at {mount}/data/studio/{csiId}/{environment}/{testId}/secrets/{name}; keys: <valueKey> (default `value`), `allowedOrigins` (comma-separated normalized origins). Version = KV v2 metadata.version.
{name, kind: secretRef, secretId}. secretId is the Vault secret name; it becomes the vars.secret reference in the revision's references document.

interactions.description: Variables dialog, row type Secret (visible only when vaultSecrets flag is on). Saved test: picker lists names from GET .../secrets; '+ Create' opens dialog (Name, Value, Allowed origins); on 201 the name is selected and the value field cleared. Unsaved test: picker disabled with hint to save first.
Secret option and picker gated by the same vaultSecrets flag; picker scoped to formData.uiTestId; disabled until a test is selected.

edgeCases.handling: Not migrated. At acceptance they resolve to UNKNOWN_REFERENCE (or fail path-safety). Author re-selects.
Vault entries remain (no delete endpoint in scope). See OQ-2.

terminology.definition: The Vault key's last path segment; equals the variable's secretId and the `<secret ID>` token.

externallyBlocked.stateInThisSpec: Default `none` retained; env-var-only activation made possible.

openQuestions.question: Is replacing (rotating) or deleting a test's secret from Studio required? This spec ships create + list only; a mistyped value must be fixed in Vault directly or by creating a new name.
Should deleting a test delete its Vault subtree? Not specified by the user.

The frozen Studio OpenAPI example (docs/specs/studio/openapi.yaml:202) and MSW fixtures use secretId `vault://studio/pilot-pw`, which is not a path-safe Vault segment. Change the example to a plain name?
Should the wizard's check-level secret overrides exist at all, given ASM-4?
